title: Article Brief + Draft
summary: For founders and small teams who write their own content: it finds the phrases people really search, reads today's Google results, one ChatGPT answer and 10 sources, then gives you a cited brief and a first draft to edit.
outcome: Pick a winnable angle for one topic, then get a cited brief and a first draft to edit.
boundary: Writes a brief and a first draft for you to edit; it never publishes, copies sources, invents statistics or examples, or promises rankings. Facts only you know stay as placeholders. One topic and one market per run.

catalog_tools.purpose: Turn the topic into up to 50 phrases people really search before checking demand.
Check monthly searches, difficulty, intent and results-page features for up to 20 phrases.
One backup demand check, after a separate yes, when no phrase has volume.
Read today's top 10 results for the target and whether an AI Overview shows; once more if the target is re-picked because Google reads it differently.
Collect Google's related questions and related searches for the target, and check with a site: search whether the site already has a page on it; backup results page when a location code is unknown.
Read the top three ranking pages.
Re-read a page whose main content came back empty; only when needed and within budget.
Record one ChatGPT answer to the reader's question and the sources it cites.
Find 10 current sources in two searches, including at least one primary source.

inputs: A topic or keyword, or a Brief this page plan from Next SEO Moves (required)
Your website, who the article is for and what they should do next (default: people who might buy from you; next step, try it or get in touch)
Country and language (default United States, English)
Your own data, examples, screenshots or opinions (optional; they make the angle yours)
Anything to avoid: claims, competitors or sources (default none)
outputs: The angle and target phrase, with monthly searches, what Google and ChatGPT show today, and whether to update a page you already have
Headings with what each must prove and its source
Questions to answer and what only you can add
A first draft with inline citations, placeholders for your examples and a meta title, for you to edit
Details: up to 10 sources, costs and limits

cost.model: Pay per call: keyword ideas and an overview, a live results page (a second only if the target is re-picked), related questions, a check for an existing page, three page reads, one ChatGPT answer and two source searches. Drafting costs nothing extra.
cost.notes: Inspected 14 October 2026: keyword ideas and the overview cost $0.016800 per call plus $0.000200 per idea or phrase; live results page $0.014000; source search $0.009800; ChatGPT answer $0.005600; page read $0.003300; related questions, site search and backup read $0.002500 each. Default maximum $0.120700, including one possible re-pick; less when a Next SEO Moves plan supplies the keyword, results page and site check. A $0.126000 Google Ads demand check runs only if no phrase has volume and you say yes. Re-inspected on every run.

approvals: Shows the maximum cost before the first paid call and waits for your yes
Asks separately before the $0.126 backup demand check, which runs only when keyword data is empty
Writes the draft after you approve the brief, or straight away if you asked for it at the start
compatibility: One Scrollport connection (CLI, MCP or API) with search, inspect, run and wallet access
A local folder or conversation state for progress, sources, the brief and the draft
